question: How many recall events (not individual product records) has Boston Scientific had for pacemakers (LWP) in total, across all years?
answer:
Across all years in the FDA recall data, Boston Scientific has **27 recall events** for pacemakers (LWP). Those events cover **110 individual product recall records**, because one event often includes several models or product lines, and each gets its own recall number.

- **Most recent event (event 98615, started 2026-03-19):** Boston Scientific released a software update (Brady SMR6) for the ACCOLADE family of pacemakers and CRT-Ps (pacemakers that pace both lower chambers). The advisory population was also expanded to include all CRT-P and dual-chamber extended life devices [Z-1770-2026].
- **Previous event (event 97467, started 2025-08-20):** a software update meant to stop devices going into Safety Mode outside the hospital when battery impedance (internal resistance) runs high. It covers the ACCOLADE family, which includes ACCOLADE, PROPONENT, ESSENTIO and ALTRUA 2. This one event has many product records, including [Z-0079-2026] through [Z-0087-2026].
- The search only returned the 10 newest records, so I can't tell you about the other events from this result. I can list them if you give me a date range or keywords such as "battery".

A recall count reflects how a company files recalls and how big its product range is. It doesn't measure how often devices fail, so it isn't a fair way to compare manufacturers on its own.
